title: Design System: Data Collection Platform Dashboard

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Start a collection or submit a configuration change.
components.css: :host { color-scheme: light dark; } .primary { --accent: light-dark(#375DDD, #7090FF); font: 400 .875rem/1.5 system-ui, sans-serif; min-block-size: 36px; padding: 4px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); border-radius: 6px; color: light-dark(#FFFFFF, #10182C); background: var(--accent); cursor: pointer; } .primary:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview: Overview pairs the first collection action with the four-stage workflow. Real activity and records carry the product story through to the Data Explorer.
keyCharacteristics: Explicit scope for job activity and quality

rules.name: Semantic status
rules.body: Pair status colors with visible state labels.

dos: Use keyboard-focusable scroll regions for wide tables.
Label the scope and time zone of operational data.
donts: Present a paginated list as the system total.
Present a duplicate count as individual duplicate records.
